name: zulfarrak
notes: Zul'Farrak (map 209), written from the world database export of tortoise-wow 5d79486 (tools/dungeongen/testdata/zulfarrak, read with export.sh) and the instance script src/scripts/dungeons/zulfarrak. FIRST-RUN ROUTE: three legs, Antu'sul, Theka the Martyr, Hydromancer Velratha, 1470 yd of navmesh path from the entrance (checked by TestZulfarrakOnNavmesh). Checked live 2026-10-14: a GM-invisible walk of the whole instance (~3130 yd, 78 walk_path calls, all arrived, no stuck spot, nothing attacked; tests/zf-map/MAP.md in the audit folder). Static spawn positions match the export to the decimal; 59 of the 64 pull-group mobs of the first draft were seen within 10 yd (two road patrollers 12 yd away, three west-road mobs out of the walker's sight); the live walk is why Theka and Velratha are met on their patrol and the patrolling packs have a 30 yd radius.

Left out of this plan because the driver cannot do them yet (all listed in dungeons/zulfarrak-extra.json or here): (1) Witch Doctor Zum'rah (7271): faction 35 (friendly) until the area trigger 962 (at_zumrah, centre 1909.3 1015.1 11.5, radius 10) fires, and a trigger is only taken from a client packet; the TortoiseBots bots send CMSG_AREATRIGGER only when their master does, and the remote agent stays outside. dungeongen -check -strict would also flag a faction 35 boss. Needs an area_trigger step the agent takes while standing in the instance, or a bot-side order. (2) The stairs event (Sergeant Bly's crew in the cages at the top of the pyramid stairs, three waves of Sandfury trolls, wave 3 summons Nekrum Gutchewer 7796 and Shadowpriest Sezz'ziz 7275: they have NO spawn row, the instance script summons them) and (3) Chief Ukorz Sandscalp + Ruuzlu: Ukorz sits behind the End Door (146084), which only Weegli Blastfuse (7607) opens, through his gossip menu after the stairs event; the driver has no gossip/talk step, and a wait inside a step does not fight the waves. (4) Gahz'rilla (7273): summoned by the Gong of Zul'Farrak (141832, lock 459) which needs the Mallet of Zul'Farrak (item 9240, a quest item); skipped unless a Mallet is in the carrier's bags. (5) The Turtle-custom Farraki Arena wing (map y 1300-1440, z about 0: Zel'jeb the Ancient 62495, Sandfury Ritualists 62500, Champion Razjal 62498 / Juthza 62497 / Kath'zen 62496, farraki_arena.cpp): not on any route here.

No team gate is needed: every mob of the route is hostile to both teams (factions 37, 16 and 107); the friendly NPCs (Sergeant Bly's crew faction 35, Elder Wildmane 15578 faction 35 npc_flags 3 at the gong, the three arena NPCs) are not in any pull group.

The End Door (146084, 1854.5 1142.9 16.1) is shut (state ready, flags 32, seen live) and in the middle of the navmesh route between the graveyard (Zum'rah) and the gong: the navmesh has no doors, so the shortest Theka -> Velratha path (562 yd) walks THROUGH the closed door (a GM did, live; bots would too, a player could not). The Velratha leg therefore starts west of the junction at (1645 909) and goes north by the west road (366 yd from the junction, walked live in 12 hops with no replan); no leg may route through the door, which TestZulfarrakOnNavmesh checks along the whole path. The graveyard (x 1832-1898, y 967-1054, about 70 Shallow Grave chests 128308/128403 with a trap 128972 each) is also off every route of this plan.

Entry: needs TortoiseBots #939 (`cmd enter`). The game has no game_tele inside Zul'Farrak (game_tele 160 "Zul'Farrak" is outside, map 1 at -6801.2 -2893.0 9.0, 28 yd from the portal), so there is no entrance_tele and `.tele name` (game_tele names only) cannot put a bot inside; `.go xyz` moves only the caller; and a bot that stands in area trigger 924 (map 1, centre -6773.5 -2889.8 15.1, radius 20) is not taken in, because the module handles CMSG_AREATRIGGER only from the master (PlayerbotAI.cpp:304, TeleportAction.cpp:41-47) and a headless bot never sends its own. The remote driver therefore walks the party to the portal and sends `.bot cmd enter 924` (entrance_trigger 924, whose areatrigger_teleport row sends to map 209 at 1212.67 842.04 8.93346, o 6.28319, required level 35, which is the plan's entrance); on a module without that order the entry fails and the run says it needs #939. outside_tele "farrak" is a partial match that only game_tele 160 has, for prepare.fresh. Live: a GM's `.go xyz 1212.7 842 8.9 209` made a private instance for the mapping walk; that is not an entry for a bound party.

Scarabs (7269, 65 seen live, faction 15) swarm near Theka and are in every leg's skip list; so are the two rare elites Sandarr Dunereaver (10080) and Zerillis (10082), which the walk did not see (probably not up in a fresh instance), and Elder Wildmane (15578), absent live.

Four static Shadowcasters (5648; spawn rows 42599, 42605, 42607 at 1505-1511 845 and 42600 at 1504.9 818.6, live cluster centre 1507.4 842.1) stand 10-15 yd off the road between the packs at 1489 820 and 1522 826 and are a pull group of their own. The lone patrolling Blood Drinker (5649, spawn 1793.5 753.4) was seen live 44 yd out at 1801.2 797.1, by the start of the Theka leg, so its radius is 50.

ZF-1 (2026-10-14) and TestZulfarrakRouteHasNoUnplannedPack: four mobs of the export stood within 20 yd of this leg's navmesh route in no pull group, besides the pack of rows 38009-38011: the wandering Blood Drinker 45709 (1685.9 888.8, added to the group at 1681 872), the Blood Drinker 81452 (1713.7 784.1) and the Witch Doctor 81468 (1776.9 813.7, on the slope), now groups of their own.

The road x 1485-1535 by direct hops (ZF-2: 1485.6 825.5 -> 1498.7 829.9 -> 1506 844.9, z 8.9-10.2; ZF-1 run 4: -> 1520 840 -> 1535 834): the agent's navmesh routes this stretch north over the ramp (1561 955), which the server refuses or which leads into the Farraki arena; the hops were walked live in both runs (ZF-1 kept the 1505 846 via; 1506 844.9 is 1.5 yd from it). Plan check (#187): the hops to 1520 840 and 1535 834 are plain waypoints now (complete straight paths of 15 and 16 yd); the second was refused no-los when a fight begun by the pack at 1535 826 had dragged the lead bot onto the ledge at 1534 815. 1535 834 is the leg's `to`, so it is not a via of its own.

The pack at 1680.8 871.5 (spawns 44225 + 45708, linked, and the wandering Blood Drinker 45709) is three mobs, but every pull of it in ZF-1 hires-3 drew far more: the pair of Shadowhunters (7246, spawn 155626 with 44170) walks a 316 yd loop through 1643-1707 874-930 that passes 10 yd from the pack (its waypoints 22-24) and through the Shadowcaster + Soul Eater pair at 1642-1645 902-906; in run 4 a pet aggroed that pair from the pull spot (33 yd), the Shadowhunters joined, then the camp of 1660-1673 896-911 (Shadowcaster 44162, Witch Doctors 44164, 44165, 44169) came on the tank: twelve mobs, wipe in 34 s. So the pair is now a pull group before the pack, both carry the Shadowhunters' patrol (the driver waits for it to walk away or pulls it alone first, and Polymorphs a Shadowhunter that joins), and the camp of four stays out (keep fights south of y 885). The Witch Doctor 45710 patrols 1658.5 805.5 <-> 1679.9 858.1 (45 s round) and can join the pack from the south: no pull group (its spawn stands 15-20 yd from the Shadowhunter camp of 1639-1645 798-815); the walk's pulls on the way and the reactive CC take it.

legs.name: courtyard
notes: PR B (zulfarrak events design, TortoiseBots #984). The courtyard of the pyramid after Velratha, east along y 1147-1166 from the junction at the east end of the gong strip; nine pull groups, every member checked against the export (creatures.tsv: spawn rows 81526-81551, positions to the decimal). The first is a lone patrolling Soul Eater (row 81550 at 1757.2 1141.2, movement type 2, radius 30) that the design list did not have: it stands 6 yd from the navmesh path to `to` (TestZulfarrakRouteHasNoUnplannedPack found it), so the party meets it on the walk and the group is then cleared by the kill. The Soul Eater 81541 (7247) and the Sandcrawler 81531 (8095) and Witch Doctor 81526 (5650) of group 6 are movement type 2 (patrols): their groups have a 30 yd radius, as the road packs of the Antu'sul legs have. The two Shadowhunters 81528/81529 at 1819-1829 1116-1121 z 25-29 are on the ramp above (the ukorz leg of zulfarrak-extra.json), the scarabs (7269) are skipped. The End Door (146084 at 1854.5 1142.9 z 16.1) is shut: the navmesh path from here to the next leg stays 25 yd from it (TestZulfarrakOnNavmesh).

legs.name: zumrah
notes: PR B (TortoiseBots #984). Witch Doctor Zum'rah (7271, spawn row 81524 at 1912.17 1016.11 11.6) is friendly (faction 35, flag IMMUNE_TO_PLAYER 0x100) until area trigger 962 (at_zumrah, centre 1909.27 1015.11 11.5, radius 10) fires, and a trigger is taken only from a client packet. The step is by auto: the lead bot walks to the stand (1903 1014 11.8, 6.4 yd from the centre, 9 yd from him and 6 yd from the Campfire 2061 at 1909.5 1016.1 that a stand on the centre would be in) and the module takes the trigger for it when AiPlayerbot.BotAreaTriggers lists 962 (TortoiseBots #1002); when `unit 7271 hostile` does not hold 5 s later the agent's own character does it (.appear to the lead bot, a walk into the zone, the packet, a walk back). Live 2026-10-15 (tests/zf-probe-events, zf-probe-zumrah): trigger 962 sent from 1909.3 1015.1 turns him from faction 35 to 37 and he yells; he keeps the flag until combat, but aggroes a bot at 27 yd (the `to`, 1885 1012) within about 2 s on his own and the flag clears in combat, so the bots can fight him. In combat he summons Zombies (7286) and Dead Heroes (7276) and a Ward (7785): kill_first [7785] sends the party at the ward first (the remote driver reads boss.tactics.kill_first). The leg walks THROUGH the graveyard (about 70 Shallow Grave chests 128308/128403 with a trap 128972 each; the straight 53 yd line from 1859 1058 to 1885 1012 passes 0.3 and 0.8 yd from two traps at 1867.7 1041.8 and 1862.1 1050.8, a detour via 1854 1055 and 1860 1037 keeps 4 yd clear of every grave and costs 8 yd): companions_loot false has the bots' looting off for the whole leg so that none opens a grave chest. The route from the courtyard goes by the pyramid's south-west side (1877 1131, 1858 1061), never within 12 yd of the End Door.
